arguments.title: Project Harbour
arguments.notes: Welcome everyone. Today we ask for a decision on the delivery option for Project Harbour.

arguments.title: Why change now
arguments.notes: The cost figure comes from the finance review in June. Stress that the staffing risk is the most urgent.
arguments.body:
Depot routing still runs on spreadsheets built in 2014
Rescheduled deliveries cost us EUR 2.3 million last year
Two of five depots lose their routing lead in 2027
Customers now expect a two-hour delivery window

arguments.title: What we heard from the depots
arguments.notes: We interviewed 46 people across all five depots in August and September.
arguments.body:
Planning
  - Plans are rebuilt by hand every morning
  - Late orders break the plan
Drivers
  - No live view of traffic or road closures
  - Paper delivery notes still in use at three depots
Customers
  - Delivery windows are too wide

arguments.notes: This is the single number to remember. The industry benchmark is around 15 percent.
arguments.body: of deliveries were rescheduled at least once in 2025

arguments.title: Options considered
arguments.notes: Option B looks cheaper but carries the staffing risk from slide 2.
arguments.body:
Option A: buy a routing platform
Live in 9 months
EUR 1.4 million over three years

arguments.title: Costs and benefits of Option A (EUR thousand)
arguments.notes: Option A pays back during year 2. Savings come mostly from fewer rescheduled deliveries.

arguments.title: Timeline
arguments.notes: The pilot depot was chosen because it has the highest rescheduling rate.
arguments.body:
November 2026: select the vendor
January 2027: pilot at the Eastport depot
April 2027: roll out to all depots
September 2027: retire the old spreadsheets

arguments.title: Decision requested
arguments.notes: We need the decision today to keep the November vendor selection on track.
arguments.body:
Approve Option A and a budget of EUR 1.4 million
Appoint a business owner for routing
Review progress at the January committee

items.text: Modernising field logistics. Steering committee, 12 October 2026

Option B: extend our in-house planner
Live in 18 months
EUR 1.1 million over three years
